selection_rationale.decision: The snapshot is Core source provenance attached immutably when the execution fact is accepted. Although not venue-originated and duplicative of an Instrument attribute, it is part of the canonical economic Fill fact because it makes the historical meaning of instrument_metadata_version explicit and durable without a new resolver handle. The authority, not the field syntax, supplies trust.
for: exact immutable provenance at execution acceptance
against_considered: venue did not originate the Core field
possible future duplication with Order provenance
selection_rationale.why_not_B: A new authority solely to store the snapshot selector is redundant indirection and a new restart/durability dependency.
selection_rationale.why_not_C: No current Fill or Order reference exact-binds the required accepted source snapshot.

accepted_source_catalog_snapshot_id.structural_format: type(value) is str AND value starts with "ascat_" AND suffix is non-empty

rules: no default to base, quote, or settlement asset

legacy_policy.economic_effect_rule: A legacy representation cannot independently create an accepted effect; reconciliation to the canonical external key returns replay/conflict.

resolution_chain: existing CatalogRuntimeAcceptanceAuthority durable history/state resolves exact accepted ASCAT
future genuine WorkspaceCatalogProjection authority proves workspace and exact member

snapshot_binding_semantics.membership_rule: instrument_metadata_version must be a member of the claimed genuine snapshot for the exact instrument_id and exact source tuple; otherwise DENY
snapshot_binding_semantics.historical_acceptance: A genuinely accepted ASCAT remains historical provenance after later producer-membership revocation; revocation blocks later admissions according to M0.12 policy but does not rewrite an already accepted historical fact.
snapshot_binding_semantics.structural_identifier_validation: AcceptedSourceCatalogSnapshotId requires type(value) is str, prefix ascat_, and a non-empty suffix
snapshot_binding_semantics.authority_validation: CatalogRuntimeAcceptanceAuthority resolves the exact genuine snapshot; syntactically valid ascat_fake is not proof

order_snapshot_relationship.long_lived_order: At T2 the Fill binds the exact snapshot carried by the resolved historical Instrument metadata_version, not latest-at-T2 and not automatically T0. If execution legitimately uses the T0 version it binds that version snapshot; if an authority-valid execution binds a newer version it binds that version snapshot.
order_snapshot_relationship.metadata_refresh: does not mutate Order or prior Fill
order_snapshot_relationship.replace_order: new Order follows normal execution scope binding; no implicit snapshot inheritance

external_trade_dedupe_migration.cross_version_rule: Before any economic mutation, probe one shared version-independent external-key index. Same key + same economics is REPLAY_SUCCESS and retains first canonical fact; same key + different economics is FILL_IDENTITY_CONFLICT with no mutation. Representation version never creates a second key.
external_trade_dedupe_migration.economics_comparison: all execution economics are compared independently of representation version; provenance mismatch is conflict/reconciliation, never a second effect
external_trade_dedupe_migration.proof: Both v1 and v2 normalize to the unchanged external key before effect publication; the single uniqueness decision precedes accepted-history append.

fill_id_migration.same_execution_fact: same fill_id is retained when represented as v2
fill_id_migration.conflict_rule: same fill_id with changed economics or provenance is FILL_IDENTITY_CONFLICT; a different fill_id with the same external key still creates zero duplicate effect

catalog_runtime_authority_dependency.single_authority_invariant: CatalogRuntimeAcceptanceAuthority is the sole AcceptedSourceCatalogSnapshot runtime acceptance owner; no competing Catalog authority may be introduced.
